title: Full review
vocabFocus: A longer story across four weeks
listenFocus: Re-listen to a longer beginner story
practiceFocus: A 10–15 minute story: present, past, and future

points.title: Every time frame together
points.rule: Present for who you are and your routine, from weeks one and two. Preterite and imperfect for a trip, a childhood memory, and an anecdote that uses both. Future for a plan. Object pronouns, possessives, and demonstratives so you do not repeat every noun. If a sentence needs anything else, describe around the missing word and keep talking.

examples.spanish: Soy… Vivo… Trabajo… Tengo que… Puedo…
examples.english: Present: who you are, routine, ability, obligation.
Past: events, and background with an event.

examples.spanish: Cuando era niño… Cuando era niña…

grammar.notYet: Any pattern you cannot use in the 10–15 minute story.

phrases.spanish: Hola, me llamo Alex. Vivo en Londres y trabajo como ingeniero.
phrases.english: Hi, my name is Alex. I live in London and work as an engineer.

phrases.spanish: Mis amigos tienen que trabajar hoy, pero yo puedo descansar.
phrases.english: My friends have to work today, but I can rest.

phrases.spanish: El año pasado viajé a Portugal. Hizo mucho sol y comimos muy bien.
phrases.english: Last year I travelled to Portugal. It was very sunny and we ate very well.

phrases.spanish: Cuando era niño, vivía cerca de la playa y jugaba todos los días.
phrases.english: When I was a child, I lived near the beach and used to play every day.

phrases.spanish: Estaba en un café cuando conocí a mi mejor amigo.
phrases.english: I was in a café when I met my best friend.

phrases.spanish: Me gustan los viajes y me duele un poco la espalda de tanto trabajar.
phrases.english: I like travelling and my back hurts a bit from working so much.

phrases.spanish: El próximo año viajaré más y tendré más tiempo para mi familia.
phrases.english: Next year I will travel more and have more time for my family.

phrases.spanish: Ten cuidado y descansa cuando lo necesites.
phrases.english: Take care and rest when you need to.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Hola. Me llamo Alex. Soy de Londres y trabajo como ingeniero. Vivo cerca de la estación.
lines.english: Hi. My name is Alex. I am from London and I work as an engineer. I live near the station.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Este año tengo mucho trabajo, pero también puedo viajar de vez en cuando.
lines.english: This year I have a lot of work, but I can also travel now and then.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: El verano pasado viajé a Portugal con mi familia. Hizo mucho sol y visitamos tres ciudades.
lines.english: Last summer I travelled to Portugal with my family. It was very sunny and we visited three cities.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Cuando era niño, mi familia y yo íbamos a la costa cada verano. Era muy feliz allí.
lines.english: When I was a child, my family and I used to go to the coast every summer. I was very happy there.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Estaba en el aeropuerto cuando conocí a un amigo con quien todavía hablo.
lines.english: I was at the airport when I met a friend I still talk to.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: El próximo año viajaré a Sudamérica. Tendré más tiempo libre y podré descansar más.
lines.english: Next year I will travel to South America. I will have more free time and I will be able to rest more.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Si algo me duele o necesito ayuda, sé pedirla ahora. Eso es lo más importante.
lines.english: If something hurts or I need help, I know how to ask for it now. That is the most important thing.

practice.title: Your four-week story
practice.instruction: Give a 10–15 minute self-introduction and life story. Cover who you are, your routine and one obligation or ability, a past trip, a childhood memory, an anecdote combining both pasts, and a plan for next year.
starters: Hola, me llamo… Vivo en… Trabajo como…
tips: This is the point of the whole month: using Spanish across every time frame.
If a word is missing, describe around it and keep talking.
